title: Fourteen Springs and One Short Mark
subtitle: 气候变化 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 气候变化（环境保护·气候变化）
meta: 主题语境：气候变化（环境保护·气候变化）　|　核心词汇：dust　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 dust 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1959 my grandfather ① swept a layer of dust that no neighbour in the town would have named, and he said the sweeping was the whole of the spring. The ② dust, meaning the layer and not the storm, ran fourteen springs and stayed unnamed in the book; dust, he said, is the only thing in a town that is judged by how long it is left unswept.

Every ③ dust in that town had the same short mark at the edge of it, and the ④ dust at the end, meaning the one they kept for the bookshelf and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A dust, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to sweep; my grandfather said the sweeping is the part that fills fourteen springs.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the dust was the whole of the story, meaning the storm and not the layer. The ⑥ dust, meaning the storm and not any of that, is the only thing in a story that everybody talks about and nobody guards against; dust, he said, is either something you sweep or the only word that means both a layer and a storm. He said the storm is the part they remember.

By 1968 the ⑦ dust had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short mark. The ⑧ dust of the whole thing, my grandfather wrote in April, was one town and fourteen springs of sweeping; dust, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to sweep. She said the sweeping was never mentioned.

The ⑨ dust I remember is the one named in the report, which settled in 1980 and is still described as the quietest in the town. A ⑩ dust, my grandmother said in 1982, is the only one that improves by being swept; every dust, she said, is a storm that has agreed to look like a layer. She said the storm was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 灰尘；尘土（指那个镇子上积着的那一层）
B. n. 灰尘；尘土（指那层尘土本身，与沙尘天气相对）
C. 固定搭配：sweep a layer of dust 扫去一层尘土
D. n. 灰尘；尘土（指留给书架的那一层）
E. n. 灰尘；尘土（抽象总称，指一个镇子的除尘之事）
F. n. 灰尘；尘土（指报告上写到、被列名的那一层沙尘）
G. n. 沙尘；扬尘天气（指故事里人人都谈起却无人防范的那样东西）
H. n. 沙尘（抽象总称，指人人都谈起却无人防范的那种天气）

items.q: swept a layer of dust that no neighbour in the town would have named
The dust, meaning the layer and not the storm
the dust was the whole of the story
the dust had become a line in a report
The dust of the whole thing
A dust, my grandmother said in 1982

answers.why: sweep a layer of dust 意为“扫去一层尘土”，1959 年祖父扫去了一层镇子上没有一位邻居肯说出口的尘土。
dust 意为“灰尘、尘土”，指那层尘土本身而不是沙尘天气，它经过了十四个春天而在簿子上没有名字。
dust 意为“灰尘、尘土”，指那个镇子上的每一层尘土，每一层边上都有同一道短短的印子。
dust 意为“灰尘、尘土”，指留给书架的那一层，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
dust 意为“沙尘、扬尘天气”，指故事里人人都谈起却无人防范的那样东西，叔叔说这场沙尘就是那个故事的全部。
dust 意为“沙尘”，指人人都谈起却无人防范的那种天气而不是那层尘土，是故事里人人都谈起、却无人防范的东西。
dust 意为“灰尘、尘土”，指报告上写到、被列名的那一层沙尘，到 1968 年这层沙尘成了报告里的一行。
dust 意为“灰尘、尘土”，祖父四月写道，整件事的除尘之事是一个镇子和十四个春天的清扫。
dust 意为“灰尘、尘土”，我记得的是报告上列名的那一层，1980 年落定了，至今仍被说成镇子上最安静的一层。
dust 为抽象总称，祖母 1982 年说，一层尘土是唯一会因为被好好清扫而变得更好的东西。
